name: Auriferous-Corbel
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by magnetic pole anomalies and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Around the spatial rift remnant, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
